speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text:
The normal urinalysis and ultrasound rule out a urinary tract infection. To further investigate the episodes of apnea and anemia, please tell me if your stools are black and tarry and if you have any known family history of blood disorders.

REQUEST TEST: Hemoglobin_Electrophoresis
REQUEST TEST: Coagulation_Panel

speaker: Doctor
text:
The normal hemoglobin electrophoresis and coagulation panel results rule out hereditary blood disorders and clotting issues. Given your infant status and the combination of apnea and anemia, please confirm if you have noticed a rash on the buttocks or thighs that bleeds easily.

REQUEST TEST: Platelet_Count
REQUEST TEST: Vitamin_K_Level

speaker: Doctor
text:
The normal platelet count and vitamin K levels rule out bleeding diatheses and vitamin K deficiency. Since we have excluded infectious, hereditary, and coagulation causes for your anemia and apnea, have you noticed any bruising or petechiae, and is your baby currently on any medications?

REQUEST TEST: Reticulocyte_Count
REQUEST TEST: Iron_Feritin

speaker: Doctor
text:
The reticulocyte count of 0.8% is significantly low, indicating bone marrow failure rather than peripheral destruction of red blood cells. With normal coagulation studies, normal platelets, and no evidence of infection or hereditary disorders, this pattern suggests a failure of the bone marrow to produce cells.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Aplastic Anemia
